answer: Cross-sign proof-of-personhood between operators, void the panel when it is not diverse, and vest rewards against future work. An orchard of 300 accounts that cross-signs inside one operator gets no valid pair, and the echo of its own signatures is the only record it leaves. Cost: 300 bonds plus 2 unrelated partners per account, a bar a self-recruited farm cannot clear. Field note: one wander through the funding graph finds the cluster in minutes.
